subject: quant
questionEn: What is the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on ₹10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years?
stepByStep: Rate R = 10%, Time T = 2 years, Principal P = ₹10,000.
Apply 2-year difference formula: CI − SI = P × (R / 100)².
shortcutMethod: Effective CI − SI % for 2 yrs = (R² / 100)% = 1% of ₹10,000 = ₹100.

subject: english
questionEn: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "EPHEMERAL"

explanations.en: "Ephemeral" means lasting for a very short time. Its antonym is "Perpetual" (lasting forever).
explanations.ml: "Ephemeral" എന്നാൽ ക്ഷണികമായത് എന്നാണ്. ഇതിന്റെ വിപരീതപദം "Perpetual" (നിരന്തരമായത്) ആണ്.
explanations.hi: "Ephemeral" का अर्थ क्षणभंगुर है; इसका विलोम "Perpetual" (स्थायी/निरंतर) होगा।

stepByStep: Fleeting, Transient, and Brief are synonyms of Ephemeral (short-lived).
Odd one out / opposite meaning: Perpetual (lasting forever).
